PREFIX brick: <https://brickschema.org/schema/Brick#> PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?supertype ?subtype (COUNT(DISTINCT ?point) AS ?count) WHERE { ?point rdf:type/rdfs:subClassOf* brick:Point . ?point rdf:type ?type . ?type rdfs:subClassOf* ?supertype . FILTER(?supertype IN (brick:Sensor, brick:Setpoint, brick:Command, brick:Status)) . ?type rdfs:subClassOf ?subtype . FILTER(?subtype != ?supertype && ?subtype != brick:Point) } GROUP BY ?supertype ?subtype ORDER BY ?supertype DESC(?count) LIMIT 50
